IronCalc 0.8.3, https://github.com/ironcalc/IronCalc, commit 9bed9ec023e645101df6b6ac5aebbe0708b259fb. Distributed under the MIT license, retained here. Folio modifies the calculation Model to supply explicit filtered rows for SUBTOTAL. Folio also routes numeric TEXT formatting through its vendored ssf-rs formatter, with bounded pattern checks and value/format-code array broadcasting. The 0.36 patch supplies a host-selected workbook date system to supported date, parsing, criteria and financial paths, preserves explicit text types on import, and checks date arithmetic bounds. Source and patch notes: rust/vendor/ironcalc_base.
